row:
My name is Colin and English man living in Brazil 

I run an animal sanctuary in Brazil where rescued dogs, cats, and other animals find safety, love, and a second chance. 💚 Every day I care for them, making sure they are fed, healthy, and know what it feels like to be safe. My biggest challenge is covering the cost of food and care each month — but with your support, we can keep every paw protected. Even the smallest donation makes a huge difference. Together, we can turn compassion into action 

https://gofund.me/4725597f2
